verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm Ollama ships its own GUI app for macOS and Windows. Users describe chatting with a local LLM in a couple of clicks, with multimodal and Markdown support working. Reported limitations are no Linux version and no way to connect the GUI to a remote Ollama instance. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the chat GUI, Linux support, remote-instance connection from the GUI.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows... linux sounds out for now.
This would be perfect for setting up a non-technical friend or family member with a local LLM with just a couple clicks... Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
I am somewhat surprised that this app doesn't seem to offer any way to connect to a remote Ollama instance.
